meta.name: facility-full-v1
meta.note: Full-map segmented blockout. Geometry frame = blockout-v3.json (user-annotated target b4fa5260, coords are the target's own labels). Zone semantics = 7-zone contract (spawn/courtyard/warehouse/bridge/plant/tunnels/core) from blockout-map-full.json + spec/calibration.md. Vertical gauges from blockout-v2.json. Every segment snapped to 1m grid; major layout rhythm 10m.

openQuestions: zone_bridge: the 7-zone semantic contract (blockout-map-full.json, spec/calibration.md) includes a bridge connector; the annotated v3 target has no dedicated bridge mass. Realized as the service-tower catwalk (br-catwalk) over the east yard. Not asserted as the original bridge.

Tunnel west arm: blockout-v2.json describes a below-grade west arm under maintenance with a west portal; the annotated v3 tunnel spine starts at the checkpoint court mouth (48,-196). v3 vertical data treated as authoritative; only the checkpoint mouth + east ridge portal are realized.

roofOpening: v3 places the air re-entry opening at (-150,-100) in the service yard south of maintenanceBlock; v2 recorded host bld_maintenance roof. Annotated position honored (hd-roof-opening); host discrepancy unresolved.
West/south perimeter closure: annotated target shows rocky north + water east explicitly; the west/south fence line is inferred from world bounds (fence-w, fence-s).
Loading dock lip: bay gates are 4.5m tall; the raised dock lip itself is not modeled as a separate segment (blockout restraint).
Tunnel depth: v3 gives no elevation; -14m adopted from v2 gauge. X-ray interior visibility required.
Coordinate frame: old map-full world (768x768, tunnels y-20) vs v3 world (920x640, tunnels y-14). v3 frame is the current target per its meta note; old calibration fixture y-20 not reused.
